title: Feature Request: Recording of Pump and CGM body location
body: I have an issue where some of the areas on my body are less ideal for insulin delivery. This is from scarring under the skin. These have built up over time, to where my insulin absorption rate is slow, from those areas. I'm sure that there are others with the same issue. Being able to record those areas is a must, for me. I do have a method of doing this. But being able to record it in AAPS would be quite convenient. So I'd like to request this as a feature.

comments.body:
> This is available in AAPS 3.4

Okay. I don't remember anything being stated about this regarding 3.4. I'll be switching to that version soon.
